question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix $C,$ given by

$$
C=\begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ 8 & 7 & 7 \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $C?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3} \\ {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $-4$ times the third row to the second row.

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1}$ means that we need to add $3$ times the first row to the second row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =\begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ 8 & 7 & 7 \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ 8+(-4)(5) & 7+(-4)(7) & 7+(-4)(1) \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ -12 & -21 & 3 \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ -12+(3)(7) & -21+(3)(-3) & 3+(3)(-7) \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -3 & -7 \\ 9 & -30 & -18 \\ 5 & 7 & 1\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
